description:
Cast Hibernation Sliver by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Hibernation Sliver enters the battlefield, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 1 life.
Essence Sliver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hibernation Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
